item.title: Morning Weather for Tuesday, August 25
item.description: Good morning! It's Tuesday, August 25. Time for the weather! It's Tuesday, and the week is getting going. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be cloudy. It will reach 31 degrees, and drop down to 26 degrees. There is a 35 percent chance of rain. It's a hot one. A sun hat and a water bottle are a good idea! Remember your water bottle. Take a big sip every time you think of it. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be bright and sunny, with a high of 32 degrees. Here's a question: what is the kindest thing you can do today? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
